verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own marketing says healthcare benefits can be accessed and managed from the payroll account, and that per-paycheck deductions can be set up and calculated. That establishes a first-party health benefits offering tied to payroll, but the depth is thin. The asterisks on the benefits claim suggest a qualified or possibly partner-delivered offering. Missing for 10: documented enrollment workflows, plan administration detail, explicit sync of health premiums into payroll deductions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer and administer health insurance with enrollments and deductions synced to payroll

citations.quote: Access HR** and team benefits—including healthcare,** 401(k) plans,** and workers’ comp**—and manage everything from your payroll account.
Set up and calculate garnishments and deductions from each paycheck.
